items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: Well, Al Hurt is another one can do... Does that.

ctx.x: That's... Yeah. He'd go up there and still have a beautiful tone.

Nice, fine tone. Uh... Well, Al Hurt is another one can do... Does that. Al can take any... Any number he plays, he'll go from... Uh, in my... My way of listening, he goes from low G to... High G above. There's no head to him. I think he masters his horn very well.
You know who I heard, uh... Well, last night I was at the Cabildo Museum and they had the Eureka brass band and they had the colored brass band.
